I was supposed to fly to Cebu this coming Saturday for another 8-day vacation. I had plans to visit @infinity_spa_ph Cebu again and finally try the newly opened @cebu_alpha. But because of a recent accident and incident, I need to take a step back and focus on healing—so I’m canceling the trip for now.🥹😞😩

Good thing I was able to store the value of my flight in my travel fund (thank you, @CebuPacificAir!). For now, I’ll just stay home and rest up, so I can hopefully squeeze in some spa time next week.😉

Thankfully, I’ve got a bunch of holidays coming up—Aug 19 (Quezon City Day), Aug 21 (Ninoy Aquino Day), and Aug 25 (National Heroes Day), plus weekends and the WFH setup.☺️

So there’s definitely enough time to rest, recover, and ease back in.😊🤿

#TrafficRestrictions #TrafficDiversions 
𝗧𝗿𝗮𝗳𝗳𝗶𝗰 𝗔𝗱𝘃𝗶𝘀𝗼𝗿𝘆 – 𝗜𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗽𝗲𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗗𝗮𝘆 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟱 𝗖𝗲𝗹𝗲𝗯𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀

𝗩𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲: Rani Mahal Lawns, Golconda Fort, Hyderabad
𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗲 & 𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲: 15th August 2025, 10:00 AM

In connection with the Independence Day 2025 celebrations at Rani Mahal Lawns, Golconda Fort, the road from Ramdevguda to Golconda Fort will remain closed for general vehicular traffic from 06:00 AM to 12:00 PM on 15th August 2025. The following traffic diversions and parking arrangements will be in place to ensure smooth movement of vehicles.

𝗧𝗿𝗮𝗳𝗳𝗶𝗰 𝗗𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 (𝗼𝗻 𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗱 𝗯𝗮𝘀𝗶𝘀) -

𝗚𝗼𝗹𝗳 𝗖𝗹𝘂𝗯 𝗟𝗮𝗻𝗲: Traffic from 7 Tombs towards Golconda Fort will be diverted to Jamali Darwaza.

𝗚𝗼𝗹𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗱𝗮 𝗕𝘂𝘀 𝗦𝘁𝗼𝗽: Traffic from GHMC Ground / GHMC Island will be diverted to Mothi Mahal X Road.

𝗧𝗮𝘄𝗮𝗸𝗮𝗹 𝗦𝘁𝗼𝗿𝗲, 𝗕𝗮𝗱𝗮 𝗕𝗮𝘇𝗮𝗿: Traffic from Bada Bazar towards Golconda Fort will be diverted to GHMC Island.

𝗜𝗯𝗿𝗮𝗵𝗶𝗺 𝗠𝗲𝗱𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗛𝗮𝗹𝗹: Local traffic from Chota Bazar towards Golconda Fort will be diverted to Mothi Darwaza.

𝗥𝗮𝗺𝗱𝗲𝘃𝗴𝘂𝗱𝗮 "𝗧" 𝗝𝘂𝗻𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻: Traffic from Narsingi & Tippu Khan Bridge towards Golconda Fort will be diverted at Ramdevguda Junction.

𝗗𝗲𝘀𝗶𝗴𝗻𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗱 𝗣𝗮𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗔𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘀 -

𝗕𝗮𝗹𝗮 𝗛𝗶𝘀𝘀𝗮𝗿 𝘁𝗼 𝗕𝗮𝗱𝗮 𝗕𝗮𝘇𝗮𝗿 𝗠𝗼𝘀𝗾𝘂𝗲: VIPs, Ministers, and MLAs.

𝗚𝗼𝗹𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗱𝗮 𝗕𝘂𝘀 𝗦𝘁𝗼𝗽 𝗣𝗮𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴: Senior Government Officials.

𝗙𝗼𝗼𝘁𝗯𝗮𝗹𝗹/𝗕𝗼𝘆𝘀 𝗚𝗿𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱 (𝗢𝗽𝗽𝗼𝘀𝗶𝘁𝗲 𝗚𝗼𝗹𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗱𝗮 𝗟&𝗢 𝗣𝗦): Government & Non-Government Dignitaries.

𝗚𝗛𝗠𝗖/𝗢𝘄𝗮𝗶𝘀𝗶 𝗚𝗿𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱: Police & Government Officials.

𝗔𝗿𝗲𝗮 𝗛𝗼𝘀𝗽𝗶𝘁𝗮𝗹, 𝗚𝗼𝗹𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗱𝗮: Awardees & Press/Media personnel.

𝟳 𝗧𝗼𝗺𝗯𝘀 / 𝗗𝗲𝗰𝗰𝗮𝗻 𝗣𝗮𝗿𝗸 / 𝗛𝘂𝗱𝗮 𝗣𝗮𝗿𝗸 (𝗶𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗱𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴): General Public & Visitors.

𝗔𝘁 𝗦𝗲𝗰𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗿𝗮𝗯𝗮𝗱 𝗣𝗮𝗿𝗮𝗱𝗲 𝗚𝗿𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱𝘀 -

Traffic will be diverted at Tivoli Junction towards Brooke Bond and N.C.C Junction. Traffic from Tivoli towards Plaza will be restricted from 06:00 AM to 10:00 AM.

𝗣𝘂𝗯𝗹𝗶𝗰 𝗔𝗽𝗽𝗲𝗮𝗹 -

Residents in the surrounding areas of Golconda Fort are requested not to park vehicles on main approach roads to the Fort.

Commuters are advised to use alternative routes and follow the traffic signage.

𝗙𝗼𝗿 𝗹𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗳𝗳𝗶𝗰 𝘂𝗽𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗲𝘀:

Facebook: https://t.co/RMgFu4rSW3

Twitter: @HYDTP

Traffic Helpline: 9010203626 (for travel assistance in emergencies)

The Hyderabad Traffic Police seeks the cooperation of all citizens to ensure the smooth conduct of the Independence Day celebrations.
